Test: TC-1052 — Feature area - Exporting - Exporting Risks
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-94 Feature area - Exporting

Steps:
1. Navigate to Risks module of boxName
   Data: TS-94 Feature area - Exporting
   Expected: Risks module is successfully loaded.
2. Click on Table button
   Expected: Risk table is displayed
3. Click the Export button in the module's header
   Expected: Export manager is displayed, with folLowing options available:
- Export to image - PDF
- MS Excel Basic Template - XLSX
4. Export to MS Excel Basic Template  - XLSX file and check if data in file are correct
   Expected: Downloaded files' names are folLowing the filename schema:
_module name_<current-date>_<current-time>.<chosen-format>_

All tasks are exported with their data:

* Type
* Issue Type
* Status
* Summary
* Modification Time
* Risk consequence probability
* Risk probability
* Key

Cells of risk probability and consequence are colored, depending on their value.
5. Export to image  - PDF file and check if data in file are correct
   Expected: Downloaded files' names are folLowing the filename schema:
_module name\_<current-time>\_<current-date>.<chosen-format>_

Image presents the entire risk matrix, with all the task cards.

Image is complete and not cut off in any way.

Tasks' keys are clickable and lead to pages with task details.
6. Close Export manager
   Expected: Export manager is closed
7. Click Matrix button
   Expected: Risk matrix is displayed
8. Open View menu and select all options except Compact mode
   Expected: Matrix is transposed, inverted and the cards on it are colored.
9. Export to MS Excel Basic Template  - XLSX file and check if data in file are correct
   Expected: Downloaded files' names are folLowing the filename schema:
_module name_<current-date>_<current-time>.<chosen-format>_

All tasks are exported with their data:

* Type
* Issue Type
* Status
* Summary
* Modification Time
* Risk consequence
* Risk probability
* Key

Cells of risk probability and consequence are colored, depending on their value.
10. Export to image  - PDF file and check if data in file are correct
   Expected: Downloaded files' names are folLowing the filename schema:
_module name\_<current-time>\_<current-date>.<chosen-format>_

Image presents the entire risk matrix, with all the task cards.

Image is complete and not cut off in any way.

Tasks' keys are clickable and lead to pages with task details.
11. Close Export manager
   Expected: Export manager is closed
12. If necessary, add the Risk Consequence and Risk probability fields to the table
   Expected: Risk consequence and Risk probability fields are added to Risk table
13. Click the Export button in the module's header and export to MS Excel Basic Template - XLSX file and close export manager
   Expected: The export processing is starting, the export manager window is closed.
14. Navigate to the Gantt module
   Expected: Gantt module is presented. Wait till exporting process is finish. 
Downloaded files' names are folLowing the filename schema and module name - "risk":
_module name_<current-date>_<current-time>.<chosen-format>_

* Risk consequence

Cells of risk probability and consequence are colored, depending on their value.
15. Back to Risk module and change the boxStatus
   Data: boxStatus: Closed
   Expected: The status is changed
